correctness.rationale: The period-doubling fixed point μ(0)=01, μ(1)=00 has p_j=1 iff ν2(j+1) is odd, so prefix weight H(n)=Σ_{r>=1}(-1)^(r-1) floor(n/2^r). For factor [a,a+ℓ) its excess H(a+ℓ)-H(a)-H(ℓ) is the alternating sum of binary carries γ_{2i-1}-γ_{2i} for a+ℓ. A positive term γ_{2i-1}-γ_{2i}=1 requires x_{2i-1}=1 for x=a+ℓ, hence excess <= number Q(x) of set odd-position binary digits. The least x with Q(x)>=t is 2(4^t-1)/3; the half x/2=(4^t-1)/3 doubled gives exactly t alternating carry pairs and attains it. Equality at this minimal x forces a=ℓ=(4^t-1)/3 by the binary carry transition constraints, yielding uniqueness. Thus Δ(N)=floor(log_4(3N/2+1)), with dyadic boundary from threshold inequalities. Independent exhaustive factor-endpoint calculations over all initial prefixes through N=1400, including unique witnesses at 2,10,42,170,682, agreed. The all-N result is a symbolic carry proof, not an extrapolation.
